name: Measure It
description: Every kind of measuring a primary school teaches, for the US, UK and Cambodian curricula: comparing, units, rulers, mass, capacity, temperature, time, area, volume, angles and converting. Built phase by phase; this release covers comparing length, mass and capacity, measuring with blocks, cubes and cups, reading rulers in cm, mm and inches, estimating, reading scales, jugs and thermometers, and word problems.
author: Koda Math Lab
tagline: Compare, measure, and know what the numbers mean.

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Reads the lesson prompt and the How to play captions aloud. Turn off for a silent lesson.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays a short sound when something moves, and when an answer is right or wrong.

features.name: Haptic vibration
features.description: Adds a small vibration when an answer is right or wrong.

features.name: Instrument motion
features.description: The balance beam tips, water rises, the scale needle swings and the thermometer climbs. Off: each one jumps straight to its value.
